drivingQuestion: Are Jews excluded from the category of descendants of Noah?
outcomeNote: Jews are named after Abraham, not Noah

segments.he: גְּמָ׳ וְיִשְׂרָאֵל מִי נָפֵיק מִכְּלָל בְּנֵי נֹחַ? כֵּיוָן דְּאִיקַּדַּשׁ אַבְרָהָם, אִיתְקְרוֹ עַל שְׁמֵיהּ.
segments.en: «GEMARA:» The Gemara asks: «And is a Jew excluded from the category» of the «descendants of Noah?» They are also descendants of Noah. The Gemara answers: «Since Abraham was sanctified» and designated to possess a unique role in the world, all his descendants «are called by his name» and are no longer termed the descendants of Noah.
